about: School figures that python3 src/check_sources.py --schools cannot find on their pages, read there by a person and found right (INC-0154). The check lists them apart from new findings. An entry holds only for the figure's value and the numbers in missing: if the figure changes, or stops carrying one of those numbers, validate_schools refuses the entry until the figure is read again. A figure the check can be taught to read, such as one in an image's alt text or on a second page named in also_urls, is fixed that way instead of listed here.
